decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ INTRODUCE already records that prize wins appear on the Winners page and are claimable with one click, so no additional Event is required.
The winner announcement and claim flow does not change how Chainlink VRF selects or verifies prize winners.
The post-win announcement and claim interaction does not change Big Block prize amounts, winner count, draw trigger, qualifying sales, or pool funding.
The post-win announcement and claim interaction does not change Small Block prize amounts, eligibility, cadence, recurrence, or pool funding.
The prize-claim presentation does not change Big Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, independence, or post-draw reset behavior.
The prize-claim presentation does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, carryover, or post-draw behavior.
The Winners-page claim flow does not affect the separate deferred Discord community-server requirement.
The claim location and interaction do not change the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
The prize-winner claim flow does not change secondary-sale royalty enforcement, amount, visibility, or proceeds allocation.
The source explicitly keeps commissions as automatic wallet transfers and applies one-click claiming only to prize wins, leaving the referral-commission state unchanged.
The winner announcement and claim interaction does not alter primary mint pricing or revenue allocation.
Posting winners and providing a website claim interaction does not change the NFT metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attribute.
